findings.rule: scan-scope-gap: new executable code merged outside every configured static/SAST glob
findings.note: `sast` runs `semgrep --config auto --error --quiet js/ presentations/`; `lint-js` and `static-structure` glob `js/**/*.js` and `presentations/**/*.js`. None match `scripts/**/*.cjs`. scripts/verify-hero-pan.cjs (149 LOC, new in this commit) therefore entered the repo with zero SAST and zero static-structure gating. Verifier re-ran semgrep against scripts/ directly and it exits 1 with 3 findings, proving the gap is not theoretical. Required fix: extend the sast/lint-js/static-structure scopes to cover scripts/ (and *.cjs), then re-run.

findings.rule: hardening: inline event handler introduced into a repo with no Content-Security-Policy
findings.note: onerror="this.closest('.hero__photo').classList.add('hero__photo--error')" — verified by reading the markup: a static literal attribute, no template interpolation, no user-controlled value in the expression, both the selector and the class name are hardcoded. NOT an XSS sink. It is however the only inline handler in the repo and there is no CSP anywhere; adopting a strict script-src later will require a hash/nonce or moving this to an addEventListener in main.js. Same finding at presentations/template-driven-ui/index.html:39.
